title: Benchmark Metadata Schema
description: Schema for benchmark-metadata.json files inside benchmark subprojects. Provides a machine-readable description and CDM-output-manifest for a benchmark, information not captured by rickshaw.json (deployment/lifecycle) or bench-metric.json (primary-metric/period wiring). Benchmarks are a single workload -- unlike tools, they have no 'subtools' concept; client/server is a deployment-role concept already modeled in rickshaw.json and is orthogonal to this file.

rickshaw-benchmark-metadata.description: Metadata block containing the schema version for this benchmark-metadata.json file format.

version.description: The schema version this file conforms to. Currently must be '2026.08.11'.

benchmark.description: The benchmark name. Must match the 'benchmark' field in this subproject's rickshaw.json.

description.description: A human-readable, one-to-few-sentence description of the workload this benchmark generates and what it measures.

sub-benchmarks.description: Declare for benchmarks that are really a suite of distinct, independently-selectable sub-benchmarks run under one name (e.g. a mixed-workload suite). No current benchmark subproject uses this -- it exists so a future suite-style benchmark isn't blocked by this schema. When present, omit the top-level 'cdm_indexed'/'cdm_sources'/'output_files' properties; put that information on each sub-benchmark entry instead.

description.description: A human-readable, one-to-few-sentence description of what this sub-benchmark measures.

cdm_indexed.description: Whether this sub-benchmark's results are indexed into the Common Data Model (CDM). If false, results are only available via 'output_files'.

cdm_sources.description: Present when 'cdm_indexed' is true. Same shape and vocabulary note as the top-level 'cdm_sources' below.

items.description: A CDM metric_desc 'type' value emitted under this source.

output_files.description: Raw (non-CDM, or supplementary-to-CDM) output file names this sub-benchmark leaves in the engine's working directory.

cdm_indexed.description: For benchmarks without 'sub-benchmarks' only. Whether this benchmark's results are indexed into the Common Data Model (CDM) by its post-processing script.

cdm_sources.description: Present when 'cdm_indexed' is true. The CDM metric_desc 'source' value(s) this benchmark's data is filed under, and the metric 'type' name(s) emitted under each source. Descriptive metadata only -- not enforced at runtime against the post-processing script. The vocabulary for metric_desc's 'class'/'default-aggregation' fields is defined authoritatively in subprojects/core/toolbox/python/toolbox/cdm_metrics.py (VALID_CLASSES / VALID_AGGREGATIONS) and is intentionally not duplicated here.

items.description: A CDM metric_desc 'type' value emitted under this source.

output_files.description: For benchmarks without 'sub-benchmarks' only. Raw (non-CDM, or supplementary-to-CDM) output file names this benchmark leaves in the engine's working directory, for output not captured by 'cdm_sources'.

oneOf.description: Benchmarks with independently-selectable sub-benchmarks: CDM info lives per-sub-benchmark, not at the top level.
Benchmarks without sub-benchmarks (the common case today): a single workload. 'cdm_indexed' is required so every benchmark has a definite answer either way.
